in_arabic.name: زنية
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يدل على الفساد و الرداءة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم مشتق من الفعل زنأ، وهو يدل على الفساد و الرداءة، و قد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الأنعام آية ১೦೮ 'ولا تسبوا الذين يدعون من دون الله لئلا يسبوا الله عدوانا جهلا'، و يستخدم في بعض الأحيان لوصف الشخص الذي يرتكب الأفعال القبيحة.

in_urdu.name: زانیہ
in_urdu.meaning: نام جس کا مطلب ہے برائی اور بدی
in_urdu.long_meaning: یہ نام عربی زبان کے الفعل زنأ سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے برائی اور بدی کرنا۔ یہ نام ان شخصیات کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو بریے کام انجام دیتی ہیں۔ جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلم معاشرے میں اس کا استعمال ایک نادر نام کے طور پر پایا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: ज़ानिया
in_hindi.meaning: ज़ानिया नाम जिसका अर्थ है बुराई और दुष्टता
in_hindi.long_meaning: यह नाम अरबी भाषा के क्रिया زنأ से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है बुराई और दुष्टता करना। यह नाम उन व्यक्तियों के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो बुरे कार्य करते हैं। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इसका उपयोग एक असामान्य नाम के रूप में पाया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: زانیہ
in_pashto.long_meaning: دا نوم د عربي ژبې د فعل زنأ څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د بدره او بدکارۍ معنی ورکوي. دا نوم د هغو کسانو لپاره کارول کیږي چې بې وزله کارونه ترسره کوي. په افغانستان کې د پښتنو په دودیزو نومونو کې دا نوم ډیر استعمال شوی دی.

in_english.name: Zaniyah
in_english.meaning: Name meaning evil, corruption or wickedness
in_english.long_meaning: The name Zaniyah originates from the Arabic root 'زنأ' (z-n-') which connotes the idea of evil, corruption, or wickedness. Although not directly mentioned in the Quran, it relates to concepts of moral misconduct. Historically, it has been used to describe individuals who engage in reprehensible actions. The name holds significant spiritual and cultural implications in Islamic tradition, reflecting adverse personality traits.

data.cultural_impact: The name Zaniyah holds deep cultural significance in the Islamic community. It is derived from the Arabic language where the name 'Zaniyah' translates to 'one who causes growth or one who cultivates and nurtures'. This name holds great importance for many Muslim communities and families as they believe it conveys a sense of responsibility and dedication to growth, whether it be personal, emotional, or professional growth. It can also represent a deep connection to the natural world, as cultivating and nurturing are essential roles for farmers and caretakers of the land.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Zaniyah can be seen as a reminder of our role as stewards of our own lives and the world around us. It encourages us to be intentional and dedicated in our personal and spiritual growth. The name also carries with it the concept of divine guidance and support in our efforts to cultivate and nurture our lives, much like a gardener who tends to their plants with care and patience, knowing that the growth and flourishing is ultimately in the hands of a higher power. The name Zaniyah reminds us to approach life with a nurturing and caring attitude, both towards ourselves and others, and to trust in the journey of growth and transformation that is inherent in the human experience.
